verdict.rationale: Vendor docs consistently claim outputs are 'fully auditable' and traceable to specific literature passages or code, with cited responses from Literature/Kosmos agents drawing on 175M+ papers. However, this is entirely vendor-asserted with no independent verification, no example of an actual citation format/output shown, and no hands-on confirmation that every substantive claim in generated reports is reliably cited. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of citation accuracy, a concrete sample output showing citation granularity, and confirmation this applies uniformly across all agents (e.g., Molecules, Precedent) rather than just Literature/Kosmos.
